title: Meta-Learning-Driven Evolution of AI Agents for Adaptive Decision Support in Information Systems

contributions.purpose: 提出元学习+检索记忆的自适应DSS架构MetaDSS
contributions.mechanism: MAML/Reptile初始化(1-2步内环)+余弦相似检索记忆做warm-start
contributions.evaluation: 部署适应仅1-2梯度步(<0.1s CPU)vs微调10+步
contributions.source_quote: an integrated meta-learning and retrieval architecture for adaptive DSS,

contributions.purpose: 系统实证(预算对齐基线/消融/效应量/profiling)
contributions.evaluation: shifted任务89.5 vs 微调86.7(p<0.01,Cohen's d=0.54,小到中);元训练约2.5×成本
contributions.source_quote: systematic empirical analysis including ablations, effect sizes, and computational profiling,

contributions.purpose: 讨论局限/伦理/真实部署路径
contributions.mechanism: 定位为proof-of-concept并列供应链/临床/金融候选域
contributions.evaluation: 定性;失败模式(OOD、d=200高维)有分析
contributions.source_quote: a discussion of limitations, ethical considerations, and pathways toward real-world deployment.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We adopt a standard gradient-based meta-learning approach inspired by Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML) [1] and its first-order variant Reptile [10].
Our work draws inspiration from these developments, proposing a hybrid agent that unites meta-learning initialization with a retrieval-based memory.
